The Philippines pulled off an INCREDIBLE comeback against China to claim the bronze medal at the 2014 FIBA Asia Cup!
In a dramatic finish, Paul Lee stepped up under pressure and knocked down THREE clutch free throws with no time left on the clock to seal an unbelievable 80-79 victory!
China was just seconds away from taking the win, but the Philippines NEVER GAVE UP!
A HEART-STOPPING finish that gave Filipino basketball fans a moment to remember!
